content: विहृ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To take away, seize away. .²2 To remove, destroy. .²3 To let fall, shed (as tears); as in बाष्पं विहरति. .²4 To pass (as time). .²5 To amuse, or divert oneself, sport, play; विहरति हरिरिह सरसवसन्ते <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>; गन्धमादनवनं विहर्तुं गता <ls>V. 4</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 6</ls>. .²6 To go in various directions. .²7 To live. .²8 To change, alternate.
